europe_now.title: French student protests and school closures
europe_now.summary: Hundreds of French high schools have been closed as student demonstrations escalate. Protesters are calling for respect, dignity, and better working conditions.

sources.headline: Hundreds of French schools remain closed as student protests turn violent

europe_now.title: EU rejects US diesel export threats
europe_now.summary: The European Union has strongly rejected US threats to ban diesel exports unless the bloc releases additional fuel stocks. Meanwhile, France is reportedly considering releasing a portion of its reserves following the pressure.

sources.headline: EU ‘fully rejects’ US threat to ban diesel exports unless bloc releases more fuel stocks

top_stories.title: French austerity budget and public backlash
top_stories.summary: France has unveiled a cost-cutting budget that includes measures likely to impact pensioners. The belt-tightening fiscal plan has coincided with growing student protests and school closures.
